_comment: The graphs inside cat-harness's `work-plan` sub-graph, declared FROM WITHIN (#980) on the pattern of `openapi/graph.json`. Each entry is `subgraph: true` — a directory of the LAYER, listed by `resolveDirectories` with `within: "work-plan"`. Paths are relative to THIS directory. OPT-IN (`optIn: true` on its entry): off in every layer, cat-harness's own included, unless that layer lists `cat-harness.work-plan` in its own `enableSubgraphs`. Holds the bean Tool, its skills and the process-engine Tool definitions (cat-harness#991 step 23.2; proposal §4.14, rulings Q15 and Q18). The memory-store Role and its neutral tools stay in cat-harness itself, outside this sub-graph.
name: work-plan

directories.description: The `work-plan` skill package: beans, claiming, coordination, blocking, draining, restructuring, the todo list, the idle backlog and the work-plan store. Split out of `sdlc-core` in cat-harness#991 step 23.2.

The Tool definitions of the work plan and the process engine, one folder per Tool (`tools/<id>/<id>.json`, as in cat-harness's own `tools/`): the beans CLI and its manual, bean query, claim check and drain queue, `work_plan_prime` and the `workflow_*` tools. Served beside cat-harness's own Tools when the sub-graph is switched on, never when it is off.
